  import Box from "../kit/ui/box/Box.svelte";
  import Link from "../kit/ui/link/Link.svelte";
  import Text from "../kit/ui/text/Text.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../kit/utils";

  type Item = { label?: string; href?: string; current?: boolean; disabled?: boolean };

<Box tag="nav" class={cn("text-sm", className)} aria-label={ariaLabel || "Breadcrumb"} {...rest}><Box tag="ol" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{#each items as it, i (i)}<Box tag="li" class="inline-flex items-center">{#if it.href && !it.disabled}<Link href={it.href} class={cn("text-sm", (it.current ? "font-medium" : it.disabled ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"))} aria-current={it.current ? "page" : undefined}>{it.label}</Link>{:else}<Text tag="span" class={cn("text-sm", (it.current ? "font-medium" : it.disabled ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"))} aria-current={it.current ? "page" : undefined}>{it.label}</Text>{/if}</Box>{/each}</Box></Box>
